## Activity

During May 2026, Central Eye Clinic completed 205 captures. This activity represents the site’s recorded imaging workload for the month. The completed captures were processed for image-quality assessment and subsequent grading.

## Image quality

Image-quality review identified 5 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 2.4. These captures could not proceed through grading because the images did not meet the required assessment standard. The remaining captures were available for grading.

## Grading

Grading identified 62 referable results. These results were recorded following review of the available captures. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This measure indicates the midpoint of the recorded interval from image capture to completion of grading during May 2026.
